### Features
| Feature | Description |

| Scan | Measures all thirty-two targets concurrently and shows what each occupies |
| Per-drive fil
ter | Chip row of mounted volumes; scanning or cleaning can be limited to one drive, and rows with n

othing on that drive disappear |
| Risk labels | Every target is `safe` or `caution`, with a one-lin
e reason (`in-use` / `rebuild` / `elevation` / `pending-update` / `rollback` / `superseded` / `histo
ry` / `duplicate` / `database-backup` / `orphan`) and a permanent legend, so "caution" never means "

unspecified" |
| Aged deletion | `temp` and `windows-temp` only remove files older than one day; fil

es a running program still holds are skipped |
| Space assessment | Walks the disk read-only and gro
ups the result into Windows / installed software / your own files, plus the ten largest app-data fol

ders. Any row opens its folder in Explorer — click, right click, or Enter |
| Honest re-run | Re-run

ning the assessment re-measures; a plain call still answers from the ten-minute cache |
| Plan | Nin
e possible steps, ordered from zero-cost to your-decision-only; the steps the plugin can run have a

button, the rest have a copyable command |
| Entry placement | Sidebar icon, settings section, or bo

th (default) — switched from the plugin's own config card or the panel's ⚙ button |
| Behaviour sett

ings | What is preselected after a scan, and whether deleting asks first |
| Grouped list | The thir
ty-two targets are filed under seven headings — system temp, developer tools, browser caches, app ca
ches, leftover updaters, backups, orphaned data. A section whose targets all read 0 B starts folded,

so the list opens with only what there is to clean |
| Panel memory | Scan results, the selection a

nd the assessment survive switching to another panel and back |
| Agent tool | `disk_cleaner` expose

s the same five actions to the model, in readable prose |
| Bilingual | Follows the host locale serv
ice; zh and en dictionaries ship together |

### What's new
- **1.6.2** — Documentation only: the README, the in-source comment, the panel's zh/en explanations
and the tool's note legend now describe `orphan-app-data` as it actually behaves (the QQGuild folder
is offered for full deletion once no file in it has been written for 30 days), instead of claiming
four independent signals and a two-year idle period. No behaviour change; the refreshed README ships

in the npm package and the v1.6.2 Release tarball.
- **1.6.1** — Fixed the `disk_cleaner` agent too
l: `output.schema` now declares `type: 'string'`, matching the text `execute()` returns (previously
every call was rejected by the host's output validator with `tool "disk_cleaner" returned invalid ou
tput: "value" must be an object`). A real delete through the agent tool now invalidates the assessme
nt cache, the same way the panel's HTTP route does. Two regression assertions added; a prebuilt tarb

all ships on the v1.6.1 Release.
- **1.6.0** — The 32 targets are grouped under seven foldable headi

ships on the v1.6.1 Release.
- **1.6.0** — The 32 targets are grouped under seven foldable headings.
### 功能
| 功能 | 说明 |

| 扫描 | 并发测量全部三十二个目标，显示各自占用 |
| 按盘过滤 | 已挂载卷的胶囊按钮；扫描与清理都可限定单盘，该盘上为空的项会隐藏 |
| 风险标注 | 每个目标都标 `安全` 或 `注意`
，并给一行理由（`in-use` / `rebuild` / `elevation` / `pending-update` / `rollback` / `superseded` / `history

` / `duplicate` / `database-backup` / `orphan`），图例常驻，所以「注意」永远不是「说不清」 |
| 保留期删除 | `temp` 与 `windows-t

emp` 只删一天前的文件；被运行中程序占住的自动跳过 |
| 空间评估 | 只读遍历磁盘，按 Windows 自身 / 已装软件 / 你自己的文件 分组，另列占用最大的十个应用数据目录。每一行都能打

开所在目录——单击、右键或回车 |
| 重新评估真的重测 | 「重新评估」会重新测量；普通调用仍然走十分钟缓存 |
| 处理方案 | 九种可能步骤，从零风险到只能你决定；本插件能执行的带按钮，其余给可

复制的命令 |
| 入口位置 | 侧边栏图标、设置页分区、或两者都要（默认）——在插件自己的配置卡或面板 ⚙ 里切换 |
| 行为设置 | 扫描后默认勾选什么、删除前是否确认 |
| 分类折叠 | 三

十二个目标归到七个标题下（系统临时、开发工具、浏览器缓存、应用缓存、升级残留、备份快照、已卸载残留）。整类都是 0 字节的默认收起来，所以打开面板先看到的只有真能清的那些 |
| 面板记忆 | 扫描结

果、勾选、评估结果在切走再回来时都还在 |
| Agent 工具 | `disk_cleaner` 把同样的五个动作以可读文本交给模型 |
| 双语 | 跟随宿主语言服务，zh / en 字典一起发布

### 安全规则
以下在 `lib/catalog.js` 中强制，不得放宽：

- 只碰 catalog 构造出的路径，没有任何接口接受路径参数。
- 候选路径至少三段，且不能是卷根（`tooBroad`）。
- `realpath` 之后必须仍落在它所属的环境根内——在缓存目录

里种一个 junction 也扩大不了波及面。
- 遍历时遇到符号链接与 junction 一律跳过，不跟随也不删除。
- 锁定或无权限的条目计为跳过，遍历继续。
- 保留目标目录本身，只清内容。
-

「只留最新一份」这类规则一律选保守的一侧：族内只有一个成员、元数据文件缺失或哈希不是字符串、
